summary: Sentences read aloud in Catalan by volunteer speakers for Google's FLEURS benchmark, which covers over a hundred languages with the same material. One row is one read sentence with its transcript. The same material is read in every language the benchmark covers, which makes results comparable across languages; it is prepared read speech, so it says little about how an engine copes with spontaneous conversation. The whole registered split is scored, uncapped.
notes: FLEURS Catalan (ca_es) test split, 940 rows — read speech with transcripts. Substitutes for the dataset-review's proposed mozilla-foundation/common_voice_17_0 source, which no longer hosts any data files on HF (empty repo: only .gitattributes/README.md, no parquet/audio). Unlocks citrinet-512-ca and onnx-asr-conformer-transducer-ca.
